name: XERNEL Tools
shortDescription: An all-in-one Android utility toolkit for power users.
description:
XERNEL Tools bundles the everyday utilities Android power users reach for most: a fast file manager, a storage analyzer, an app manager, and a lightweight security scanner. It's built to stay out of your way, favoring clear controls over clutter, and it runs comfortably on modest hardware.

Everything works offline. No account, no ads, no background tracking — just the tools, ready when you open the app.
releaseNotes: Added storage analyzer with category breakdown
Reworked app manager for faster batch actions
Fixed a crash when scanning large SD cards
